name: Wollbrandshausen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wollbrandshausen (Saint George on horseback slaying the dragon on red).
history: Municipal flag of Wollbrandshausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wollbrandshausen arms — Saint George on red
